scope: Equal-depth verification for a secured office tower within a civic-cultural enclave, a coastal memorial park whose symbolic geometry supports current health/environmental use, and a former-hacienda parish with recurring worship but permission-sensitive interiors.

sources.supports: The bank's project archive documents construction and purpose of the San Borja headquarters at the Javier Prado/Arqueología civic enclave.
The current institutional visitor registry confirms controlled official access; it does not create public photographic access or an observation deck.
Official maintenance specification describes a working office tower and 16-elevator vertical circulation system; contract date is historical and current condition requires field confirmation.
A recurring Monday 09:00-10:00 functional-training program for older adults was published for Parque María Reiche in January 2026; confirm continuation before route.
A March 2026 environmental activation and PTAR visit link the park's public landscape to recycled-water infrastructure.
The municipal 2025 infrastructure-gap diagnosis records deficient paths/services/signage at Parque María Reiche; this is a currentity warning, not proof of unchanged 2026 condition.
Official district history ties the church/convent to donated former-hacienda land, Pasionist arrival in 1926 and the parish's urbanization role.
The current parish page publishes recurring weekday, Saturday and Sunday Mass and office schedules at Víctor Andrés Belaúnde 160.
Institutional history documents the church's development and transferred historic altarpiece, establishing temporal layering but not current interior photography permission.

contradictions: The tower is an operating secured headquarters, not a public viewpoint; a visitor registry does not imply walk-in or photographic access.
Height and landmark status establish identity but add no competition value.
Historic elevator/project records describe intended systems but do not verify 2026 pedestrian peaks, reflections or internal access.
composition_questions: Can podium, controlled entrance and vertical office system visibly compress metropolitan commuting into one architectural threshold?
Which tower silhouette, neighboring landmark, reflection or traffic stream turns the frame into generic corporate/city spectacle?
Does a public ground position reveal tower-to-civic-enclave circulation, or would the story require inaccessible elevated/interior views?

source_truth.answer: The Torre Banco de la Nación is the bank's operating San Borja headquarters with controlled institutional access in the Javier Prado civic-cultural enclave.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Podium, secured lobby, office floors and a high-capacity elevator core organize concentrated public-bank administration vertically.

current_life.answer: Employees, registered visitors, security and service personnel arrive, screen, wait, ascend and exit; density and public-edge behavior require direct observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Arrive, queue, screen, badge, wait, ascend, work and exit are credible/evidenced. A guarded empty threshold may express controlled institutional capacity.

architectural_causality.answer: Podium and security compress horizontal city arrival into a vertical elevator system; the surrounding enclave supplies scale only when linked to that transition.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Isolated tallest-tower silhouette, reflection and megaproject aerial dominate. The underused relation is ground-level institutional intake against the larger civic enclave.

light_material_geometry.answer: Low light can separate podium, glass plane and human intake; reflection is useful only when it clarifies neighboring public systems rather than decorating the tower.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public podium tangent, cross-enclave section and controlled-entry diagonal. Start 35 mm for tower/ground relation, 50 mm for intake and 85 mm only if podium remains legible.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Remain in public space, do not photograph badges, screens, guards or security details, request permission for property positions and kill every hypothesis requiring upper-floor access.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when tower architecture visibly converts metropolitan arrival into controlled vertical work. Height, skyline, reflection or caption-only civic context fails.

A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude neighboring landmark clutter and clipped podium

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Approach, pause and entry form three stages
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No badges, faces, guards or screens

C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Commuter crosses between public institutions and bank threshold

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public diagonal joining metropolitan approach, secured podium and vertical tower
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Crossing, waiting and entering occupy layered zones

contradictions: A recurring 2026 Monday class was announced, but continuation and exact location must be confirmed before route.
The 2025 municipal diagnosis records deficient paths/services/signage; it cannot be assumed unchanged in 2026.
Repaired LED figures and published lighting hours require same-day verification after repeated vandalism/repair.
composition_questions: Can Nazca-derived ground geometry, coastal path and current exercise/environmental use form one legible system rather than a symbolic decoration?
Which ocean sunset, glowing glyph, child/family event or tourist group turns the frame into a familiar malecón postcard?
Does a ground-level diagonal make bodies trace the geometry, or is an unavailable elevated view required for the concept?

source_truth.answer: Parque María Reiche is an active Miraflores coastal public space hosting recurring exercise and 2026 environmental programming linked to recycled-water infrastructure.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Paths, lawns, Nazca-derived luminous figures, overlooks and service infrastructure combine memorial interpretation with recreation and coastal movement.

current_life.answer: Older adults exercise; residents learn, walk and gather around water/environmental programs. Routine tourism, play and lighting condition remain field checks.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Exercise, balance, stretch, walk, learn, inspect, gather and overlook are evidenced. Empty illuminated lines can imply orientation only when paths and coastal edge remain visible.

architectural_causality.answer: Ground figures, paths, exercise/gathering lawns and the PTAR-supported green system organize bodies and maintenance across the cliff-top landscape.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Ocean panorama, sunset and glowing-glyph views dominate. The underused relation is bodily movement tracing symbolic/maintenance infrastructure at ground level.

light_material_geometry.answer: Blue hour can make luminous lines, paths and figures co-legible; garúa can expose lawn/path geometry. Illumination failure is a route gate, not a reason to invent effect.

position_then_optics.answer: Test low path/line tangent, exercise-zone reverse and PTAR/landscape relation where publicly visible. Start 35 mm for geometry/use, 50 mm for gesture and avoid telephoto ocean compression without causality.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm class, LED and path condition; do not identify vulnerable participants or children; stay off planted/light elements and avoid obstructing exercise or cliff-edge circulation.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when memorial geometry and ecological/recreational infrastructure visibly channel present bodies. Sunset, glyph postcard or event documentation fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public low path tangent holding one ground figure, route and coastal edge
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude ocean-dominant horizon and clipped glyph

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adults balance, stretch and cross in distinct zones
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No vulnerable close-ups or instructor branding

C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No sunset or perfect glyph overview

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.kill_trigger: LED damaged/off or pure glow study

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public diagonal joining symbolic ground line, active lawn/path and coastal/service edge
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Exercise, crossing and maintenance/observation occupy layers

contradictions: Current Mass schedules establish recurring worship but not attendance density or photography permission.
The historic altarpiece and former-hacienda origin are genuine, but neither is automatically legible from a public exterior frame.
Interior worship photography must be explicitly authorized; service attendance is not consent.
composition_questions: Can donated hacienda edge, convent/church threshold and present parish arrival reveal how an agrarian institution became an urban community anchor?
Which frontal symmetry, wedding decoration, gilded retablo or congregation crowd reduces the image to church documentation?
Does a permitted threshold position connect street, narthex/nave and ritual movement, or is the historic layering only caption knowledge?

source_truth.answer: Nuestra Señora del Pilar is an active San Isidro parish on land donated from the former hacienda, with Pasionist origins and current recurring liturgical/office schedules.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Convent/retreat house, temple, broad nave, tower/entry and transferred historic altarpiece created worship and community infrastructure for a newly urbanizing district.

current_life.answer: Parishioners arrive, worship, confess, gather, receive services and leave across repeated daily/weekly windows; exact density and ceremonies vary.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, enter, wait, pray, confess, gather and depart are evidenced. A quiet threshold between services can express recurring ritual expectation without intruding on worship.

architectural_causality.answer: Street approach, tower/portal, nave axis, convent edge and historic retablo sequence urban movement into communal ritual and preserve layered hacienda memory.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Frontal church, wedding and ornate-altarpiece coverage dominate. The underused relation is ordinary parish movement negotiating the former-hacienda/modern-city threshold.

light_material_geometry.answer: Morning/evening light can connect portal, nave axis and layered materials; interior retablo light is valid only with permission and a present ritual/spatial relation.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public street-to-portal diagonal, convent/church edge and permitted narthex reverse. Start 35 mm for urban/parish sequence, 50 mm for arrival and 85 mm only when it preserves architectural cause and privacy.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm schedule and photography with parish, never photograph confession or private devotion, avoid ceremonies without consent, silence equipment and default to exterior/between-service meaningful absence.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when inherited parish architecture visibly channels a current communal ritual or expectation. Façade, wedding, altar detail or caption-only hacienda history fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public street diagonal holding tower/portal, convent edge and urban approach
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude parked cars and frontal postcard symmetry

B_HABITAR.position: Public/authorized threshold just before or after a confirmed service
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No faces, ceremony or devotional close-up

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public lateral view joining old parish/convent boundary to current commercial/residential street
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Ordinary pedestrian turns toward parish edge

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Authorized narthex/side threshold holding later church fabric and historic retablo axis
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Single consenting figure crosses temporal layers

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public/authorized diagonal joining city approach, parish threshold and ritual axis
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Passing, arriving and entering occupy distinct zones
